claims.claim: BERT performs downstream fine-tuning by adding task-specific output layers.
RoBERTa papers use distinct development and test leaderboard configurations, including model ensembles.
claims.verification_note: Disallows mixing dev/single and test/ensemble scores.

claims.claim: ELECTRA introduces replaced-token detection with generator-discriminator pretraining and downstream discriminator reuse.
claims.verification_note: Model family comparison constrained to mechanism.

claims.claim: ALBERT reduces parameter storage with factorized embedding parameterization and cross-layer parameter sharing.
claims.verification_note: Parameter count does not directly equal FLOPs.

claims.claim: DeBERTa disentangles content and relative position representations.
claims.verification_note: Subsequent version differences not flattened into single numbers.

claims.claim: DistilBERT uses knowledge distillation for a smaller student model.
claims.verification_note: No untested latency benchmark is imported.

claims.claim: ModernBERT extends native context to 8192 tokens under its reported recipe.
claims.verification_note: Long context supported but measured runtime depends on task/hardware.
